description: Vidrush Artlist live — ricerca reale su Artlist separata dallo stock YouTube. Verifica: live search→stream URL→download MP4→FFprobe valido→Drive upload→SQLite insert→outbox event→Qdrant index→binding Vidrush. La cache negativa NON deve rendere permanente una ricerca vuota.

items.title: Artlist live: cinematic stock footage discovery
items.style: Write a visually rich narrative using cinematic language. Each segment should evoke a scene that maps well to stock footage categories: nature, urban, lifestyle, technology, sports.

source.topic: Cinematic stock footage scenes for Artlist live discovery
source.source_text:
Aerial drone footage reveals a winding coastal road at golden hour. Turquoise water crashes against cliffs as a red convertible traces the curves.

A barista crafts latte art in a sunlit specialty coffee shop. Slow motion captures the milk swirling into the espresso crema.

A trail runner ascends a mountain ridge at sunrise. The camera follows from behind as the runner crests the summit and takes in the panoramic view.

Operational marker: vidrush-07-artlist-live.

segments.topic: Aerial coastal road at golden hour with turquoise water and cliffs
Barista making latte art in a sunlit specialty coffee shop
Trail runner climbing a mountain ridge at sunrise

per_segment.artlist_candidates_present: candidati Artlist presenti per ogni segmento (best-effort)

live_pipeline.search: POST /api/artlist/search eseguito con query generate dai segmenti
live_pipeline.stream_url: stream URL reale ottenuto da Artlist
live_pipeline.download: MP4 scaricato e verificato con hash
live_pipeline.ffprobe: FFprobe valido: durata > 0, codec video presente, risoluzione > 0
live_pipeline.drive: file caricato su Google Drive con link valido
live_pipeline.sqlite: record inserito in media_assets con drive_link popolato
live_pipeline.outbox: evento outbox prodotto per ogni asset indicizzato
live_pipeline.qdrant: embedding inserito in Qdrant con metadata corretti
live_pipeline.binding: binding Vidrush associa ogni segmento a un candidato Artlist

assertions.no_permanent_negative_cache: una ricerca Artlist vuota non viene memorizzata permanentemente in cache negativa
assertions.retry_on_miss: un miss Artlist viene ritentato a run successive (cache negativa con TTL)
